claims: Croatia defeated Colombia 2-1 in an international friendly on March 26, 2026, at Camping World Stadium in Orlando, Florida.
Jhon Arias scored for Colombia in the 2nd minute.
Luka Vušković scored for Croatia in the 6th minute.
Igor Matanović scored for Croatia in the 42nd minute.
Jhon Arias's goal was assisted by Luis Suárez, as shown on Total Croatia.
Luis Suárez missed a significant chance to score for Colombia.
Croatia vs Colombia match was a 2026 World Cup preparation match.
Croatia vs Colombia friendly was part of the preparations for the 2026 World Cup for both teams, notes beIN SPORTS.
